headline: Balsamic Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
description: Bring on the bacon! Brussels sprouts with bacon become a crowd favorite when smothered in balsamic and topped with homemade bacon bits.
name: Balsamic Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
recipeIngredient: 1 pound Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved or quartered

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a 15x10-inch baking pan with foil.
Place Brussels sprouts into the prepared pan. Drizzle 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar and olive oil on top. Season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Roast in the preheated oven, stirring every 5 minutes, until Brussels sprouts are crisp-tender and brown, 15 to 20 minutes.

While Brussels sprouts roast, place bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned and crisp, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain bacon slices on paper towels. Crumble when cool enough to handle.
Drizzle roasted Brussels sprouts with remaining 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar and sprinkle with crumbled bacon and lemon zest.

review.reviewBody: This was an excellent recipe, very tasty. Time in the oven was more like 28-30 minutes. I could do without the lemon zest but my wife loves lemons and enjoyed it very much. I doubled the recipe but rather than adding another 1-2 tablespoons of balsamic vinegar after the oven, I used drizzles of balsamic reduction. That was awesome because it left the sprouts with a hearty coating. I pan fried the bacon and as it was a little to supple, I decided to throw it in with the sprouts for the last 5 minutes to cook and crisp up a little more. I think the extra bacon grease that rendered out added even a little more bacon flavor to the recipe. A winner!

Well it's been 🥓 baconized a whole lb for 2 lbs of yummy Brussel Sprouts !! I of course remodeled your recipe just a tad adding 3 tbl spoons balsamic vinegar ( brand name Gran Deposito) of Modena Giuseppe Giusti founded in 1605 !!! An Italian vintage Balsamic Vinegar the Best of the BEST !!! And I added a couple secret ingredients ? Thank so much for laying the groundwork of this amazing 🤩 recipe !!
These were so good. I did put the bacon on before the oven and skipped the lemon. I probably used a bit more balsamic too. Very good!

This made for some absolutely wonderful Brussels sprouts!! So delicious when roasted like this! I used some thinly sliced pepper bacon, and left out the lemon zest. It was fantastic, and so easy to make! I will definitely be making these again! Thank you for the recipe!
Great way to add delicious veggies to your meal! Used only bacon grease no olive oil it wasn’t needed. Used more bacon it was fantastic!!
I am not a big fan of Brussels sprouts, but, these are delicious! I quartered the sprouts so there were be more surface for becoming carmelized.
Tasty, I added mushrooms to mine as well. But came out very good. Recommend it to anyone looking for a healthy meal.
We love brussel sprouts and this recipe is not typically how we make them. I think next time I will omit the lemon zest and add a cheese like feta or blue cheese.

Good recipe! I had never tried them with Balsamic Vinegar and it is fantastic! And the lemon zest adds lots of flavor! I did not cut them because they were small but will next time. I will make again!

I used more sprouts than this and just sort of eyeballed the balsamic vinegar These were very good! Sorry the bacon didn't wind up picture-worthy, that was my fault and not the recipe's fault so I didn't include it in the photo!

We both really enjoyed this recipe, and I'm not a sprouts fan. The balsamic was a great addition and the crispy bacon just took it over the top. I also really liked the little bits that had a bit of a char. Very good and a keeper.
This was a nice variation to Brussels sprouts. I think roasting Brussels sprouts always bring our their best flavor.
This recipe was delicious just as written. I loved the combination of flavors. Do not omit the fresh lemon zest garnish!
